t: Danaher (Armstrong?) Craftsman Pro wrenches | The Garage Journal
s: November 23, 2018 - There are several series Matco wrenches, The US made MCL series are whats being considered the same as the Craftsman pro & Armstrong. These are the different suppliers for Matco wrenches, WCL series; Bonney OEM RCL series; Not sure of the OE, have not been able to find out. It wasnt Bonney as they went out of business around '94 IIRC. I had thought possibly Wright as they made ratchets for Matco at one time, No conclusive evidence. MCL series; made by Danaher/Apex, parent company of Allen/KD/Armstrong/Gearwrench/ contracted Craftsman & Napa tools as well.
